instrument: SNTS Style track (clone) / Kick (G) / StandardCLIP / Clipping (threshold)
hypothesis: SECOND knob on the SAME real kick, chosen as a CLEANER crest control than Decapitator Drive (which humped near 0.6). StandardCLIP is a hard/soft clipper; its 'Clipping' param is the clip threshold in dB (linear: threshold_dB = 144*value - 120). Sweeping value 0.6 (-33.6 dB, heavy clip) -> 0.9 (+9.6 dB, no clip) should raise the threshold past the kick's peak, so clipping releases the transient and crest (peak/RMS) rises MONOTONICALLY. Expect a smooth S-curve: flat-low (fully clipped) -> steep rise as threshold crosses the kick peak -> flat-high (unclipped native crest). Single variable: ONLY StandardCLIP enabled (Decapitator devices[1] turned OFF for this run), Input Gain/Output Gain/Softness/Clip Type all fixed, post-mixer stereo tap (crest and sub_share are gain-invariant). If this is cleanly monotonic it is the better crest lever for the Assistant.
